get_template_for_action: pick a random natural language template for a given action type like Move or Build
get_template_with_constraints: get a template filtered by dialogue length or no inbuilt composites constraints
get_template_with_node: get a template instantiated with a parse tree node and template attributes
review_template_map: review the template_map dictionary that maps action types to their template lists
summarize_template_selection: summarize how get_template selects and instantiates templates from the template_map
